shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '.lore/test-commands.yml' -g 'scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs' -g '*conversation*' -g '*session*' src specs .lore scripts | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'list_sessions|session_list|Validated|validated by|Status|conversation list' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts
rg --files scripts/spec-links .github/workflows | head -50
rg -n 'spec:' src/transport/ws src/types | head -30"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,230p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/createServer.ts
sed -n '1,150p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '1,130p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,120p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs
sed -n '1,140p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs
rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]|@spec|spec-anchor' src | head -50
rg --files -g AGENTS.md -g '*/AGENTS.md' ."

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,200p'
nl -ba src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts | sed -n '45,90p;155,190p'
sed -n '1,75p' CHANGELOG.md
rg -n 'list_sessions|session_list|sessionListHandler' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
rg -n 'conversationList.acceptance|specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/types/messages.ts src/index.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/sessionListHandler.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/sessionListHandler.test.ts
git diff --stat
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
nl -ba src/transport/ws/sessionListHandler.test.ts | sed -n '1,60p'
rg -n 'SessionSummaryFrame|SessionListMessage|ListSessionsMessage' src/types/messages.ts src/index.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/index.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/sessionListHandler.test.ts src/types/messages.ts
git commit -m "feat(transport): answer conversation list frames"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
git status --short --branch'
